title: Privacy-preserving water quality forecasting using federated learning across distributed water monitoring nodes and optimized RPART modelling
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00758E, Paper
M. Geetha Jenifel, M. Mary Linda
This model aims to detect the water quality parameters and determine the usability of water. The integration of the federated learning and optimized RPART techniques can lead to more efficient, benefiting agriculture, and local communities.
